source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-null-entries-in-matches-and-alternatives.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: Both candidate walks (selection and the uuid census) tolerate null entries in matches and alternatives — the resolver has been seen to emit sparse arrays, and a dereference here takes the whole not-found turn down instead of just skipping a row.
